# Allied Academies

> Global open-access academic publishing platform hosting peer-reviewed journals, research articles, and international conferences across multiple disciplines.

Allied Academies is an international research organization that publishes peer-reviewed open-access journals and hosts academic conferences. The platform serves researchers, authors, and institutions worldwide with a focus on multidisciplinary research spanning medical sciences, nutrition, neuroscience, and other academic fields.

## Key Topics

- peer-reviewed journals
- open-access publishing
- academic journals
- manuscript submission

## Journal Directory & Discovery

- [Allied Academies Homepage](https://www.alliedacademies.org): Global research organization hosting academic conferences and peer-reviewed journals.
- [Journals by Title](https://www.alliedacademies.org/journals-by-title.php): Directory of Allied Academies peer-reviewed open-access journals by title.
- [Journal Directory with Impact Factors](https://www.alliedacademies.org/journals.php): Allied Academies journal directory with impact factor metrics and categories.
- [About Allied Academies](https://www.alliedacademies.org/history.php): History and background of Allied Academies organization and affiliated academies.

## Author Submission & Guidelines

- [Journal Submission Instructions](https://www.alliedacademies.org/journal-submission-instructions.php): Author instructions for journal submission and article processing charges.
- [Publication Guidelines](https://www.alliedacademies.org/publication-guidelines.php): Manuscript formatting guidelines and document preparation standards for submission.
- [Publication Policies and Procedures](https://www.alliedacademies.org/publication-policies-and-procedures.php): Editorial policies, peer-review process, and manuscript submission procedures.
- [FAQs](https://www.alliedacademies.org/faq.php): Frequently asked questions about manuscript submission, peer review, and publication process.

## Ethics & Professional Standards

- [Committee on Publication Ethics](https://www.alliedacademies.org/ethics.php): COPE guidelines, publication ethics, and research integrity standards.
- [Code of Conduct](https://www.alliedacademies.org/code-of-conduct.php): Ethical and professional publication standards and code of conduct for authors.

## Membership & Support

- [Membership Programs](https://www.alliedacademies.org/membership.php): Membership programs and benefits for individual and institutional subscribers.
- [Contact & Support](https://www.alliedacademies.org/contact.php): Contact form and information for journal inquiries and article submission support.
